g.text: Cogentic in Antigravity: automated proof discovery as a native swarm
One command, /cogentic <problem>, turns the user's own conversation into the coordinator of a swarm that reproduces the Cogentic harness of Cai et al. (2026) round by round.

g.text: creates the swarm itself; no extra agent
starts, waits for and judges workers
kills finished workers to save quota

g.text: reads the plan's models and quota
sizes the run: budget, rounds, slots
picks a model for every worker
resizes the run as quota changes
